summary: A member declines to comment to an outlet after a story about the member has damaged their relationship.
realLife: Jackie Speier declined to speak to a Hill reporter and pointed to John Solomon’s columns in the paper when explaining her objection to its coverage.
inGame: The press-comment variant reads earlier scandal coverage, the outlet, and the reporter’s tie.
gates: A relevant adverse story or strained tie is recorded.

turns.what: The member gives the reporter the roll call and declines a personal quote.
turns.pulledBy: An earlier story strained trust but the vote itself is public.
turns.writesBack: The reporter has the public record and no attributable comment.

turns.what: The member takes the call after the editor sends the correction the member requested.
turns.pulledBy: The corrected article is public and the member has read the revised passage.
turns.writesBack: The press log links the new interview to the correction and keeps the earlier refusal on file.
